race.title: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Nursery Handicap (0-60)
race.verdict: ROCK ON JOHNNY left his previous efforts well behind when winning on handicap debut here just 5 days ago and can defy the quick turnaround under a good-value 10-lb claimer. Mutamarid Lsk is feared most after improving since being gelded and switched to all-weather, while Hazy Sky is the type to do better in handicaps and would be of strong interest if well supported. ROCK ON JOHNNY (IRE) MUTAMARID LSK (IRE) HAZY SKY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Rock On Johnny (11/4), Mutamarid Lsk (7/2), Zelente (6/1), Dear Theodosia (6/1), How Now (7/1), Maxims Of Equity (12/1), Sorrento Sunset (12/1), Hazy Sky (20/1), Chiquitita Bee (20/1), Tina Tereshkova (20/1), Annie Tips (20/1), Scotty Cameron (20/1)
